import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, k, mod;
    static int[] jc, inv, jc2, Log;
    static int[][] dp;
    static boolean[][] vis;
    static List<Pair> tp = new ArrayList<>();
    static Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int f, int s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }

    static void readInt(BufferedReader br, int[] x, int index) throws IOException {
        int val = 0;
        boolean neg = false;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch == '-') {
                neg = true;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                val = ch - '0';
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1 || !Character.isDigit(ch)) break;
            val = val * 10 + (ch - '0');
        }
        x[index] = neg ? -val : val;
    }

    static int getcnt(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (x != 0 && (x & 1) == 0) {
            cnt++;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int ksm(int x, long y) {
        int ret = 1;
        long base = x;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (int)((long)ret * base % mod);
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int C(int n, int m) {
        return (int)((long)jc[n] * inv[m] % mod * inv[n - m] % mod);
    }

    static int dfs(int n, int k) {
        if (n == 0) return 1;
        if (k == 0) return 0;
        if (dp[n][k] != -1) return dp[n][k];
        int ret = 0;
        int di = 1 << Log[n];
        for (int i = n; i >= di; i -= 2) {
            ret = (ret + (long)C(n, i) * dfs(n - i, k - 1) % mod * k) % mod;
        }
        return dp[n][k] = ret;
    }

    static int bfs(int n, int k) {
        q.clear();
        tp.clear();
        q.add(new Pair(n, k));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair p = q.poll();
            int x = p.first;
            int y = p.second;
            tp.add(new Pair(x, y));
            if (x == 0 || y == 0) continue;
            int di = 1 << Log[x];
            for (int i = x; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                if (jc2[i] + jc2[x - i] == jc2[x] && !vis[x - i][y - 1]) {
                    vis[x - i][y - 1] = true;
                    q.add(new Pair(x - i, y - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int i = tp.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int x = tp.get(i).first;
            int y = tp.get(i).second;
            if (x == 0) {
                dp[x][y] = 1;
                continue;
            }
            if (y == 0) {
                dp[x][y] = 0;
                continue;
            }
            int di = 1 << Log[x];
            for (int i = x; i >= di; i -= 2) {
                if (jc2[i] + jc2[x - i] == jc2[x]) {
                    dp[x][y] = (int)((dp[x][y] + (long)C(x, i) * dp[x - i][y - 1] % mod * y) % mod);
                }
            }
        }
        return dp[n][k];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        mod = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int maxSize = 262150;
        jc = new int[maxSize + 1];
        inv = new int[maxSize + 1];
        jc2 = new int[maxSize + 1];
        Log = new int[maxSize + 1];
        dp = new int[maxSize + 1][32];
        vis = new boolean[maxSize + 1][32];

        Arrays.fill(dp, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxSize; i++) {
            if (i == 0) {
                jc[i] = 1;
                Log[i] = -1;
                jc2[i] = 0;
            } else {
                jc[i] = (int)((long)jc[i - 1] * i % mod);
                Log[i] = Log[i >> 1] + 1;
                jc2[i] = jc2[i - 1] + getcnt(i);
            }
        }

        inv[maxSize] = ksm(jc[maxSize], mod - 2);
        for (int i = maxSize - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            inv[i] = (int)((long)inv[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
        }
        inv[0] = inv[1];

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(ksm(k, n));
        } else {
            int cnt = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 62; i++) {
                if (((long)n & (1L << i)) != 0) cnt++;
            }
            int ans = ksm(k, n);
            int res = ((ans - bfs(n, k)) % mod + mod) % mod;
            System.out.println(res);
        }
    }
}
